# test/fixtures — the source of each fixture's shape

Every value is synthetic, and no real ledger is included. The shapes (column order, keys, how lines are grouped, and the format of dates and amounts) follow the sources below, as checked on 2026-10-22 (invoices) and 2026-10-23 (statements).

| File | Shape source |
|---|---|
| `parity.edn` | kaikei's own table. The guest's `test-*` copy the same rows. |
| `xero-accounts.json` | XeroAPI/Xero-OpenAPI `5a115f3`, `xero_accounting.yaml`: the `GET /Accounts` example and the `Account` schema (`Type` and `Class`). |
| `xero-manual-journals.json` | Same yaml: the `GET /ManualJournals/{ManualJournalID}` example (L10477), with `Status` values `POSTED`, `DRAFT` and `VOIDED`, and `LineAmountTypes` values `NoTax` and `Exclusive`. |
| `xero-journals.json` | Same yaml: the `GET /Journals` example (L9417). `NetAmount` is positive for a debit and negative for a credit. |
| `qbo-accounts.json` | intuit/QuickBooks-V3-Java-SDK `c4d5dfa` (`Finance.xsd`), plus the Account query response sample in Intuit's developer docs. The sub-account `Truck:Original Cost` comes from the JournalEntry sample in the same docs. |
| `qbo-journal-entries.json` | The JournalEntry query response sample in Intuit's developer docs, plus `Finance.xsd`: `PostingType` and `Entity`/`DepartmentRef`. |
| `yayoi.csv` | Yayoi support "仕訳データの項目と記述形式" (page_id=18545): 25 fields, no header row, `#` comment lines, and the flags 2000, 2110, 2100, 2101 and 2111. Invoice qualifiers in 税区分 follow the 税区分 記述形式 page (page_id=18111). |
| `yayoi-sjis.txt` | The same text as `yayoi.csv`, encoded with Python's `cp932` codec. Used to compare kaikei's Shift_JIS encoder and decoder against an independent implementation. |
| `mf.csv` | MoneyForward Cloud Accounting guide "「仕訳帳」をインポートする" (import-books/ib01): 27 columns A–AA, and a compound entry with the same 取引No and 取引日. The invoice value `80％控除` uses a full-width ％. |
| `freee.csv` | The freee import template attached to help article 204847430: the 33-column header verbatim, and `[表題行]`/`[明細行]`. The first data row follows the template's own first row, with the trading partner's name changed. |
| `qbo-journal.csv` | QuickBooks Help "Import journal entries" (US). Columns are Journal No., Journal Date, Account Name, Debits, Credits, Description, Name and Location; the sub-account is written `Parent:Sub`. Dates are US mm/dd/yyyy. |
| `xero-invoices.json` | XeroAPI/Xero-OpenAPI `5a115f3`, `xero_accounting.yaml`: the `Invoice` schema (L22386), `LineItem` (L20731) and `TaxRate` (L25200), and the `GET /Invoices` examples. `Type` values `ACCREC`, `ACCPAY` and `ACCRECCREDIT`, `Status` values `AUTHORISED`, `PAID` and `VOIDED`, `LineAmountTypes` `Exclusive` and `Inclusive`, and dates as MS dates. INV-0102 has a `TaxAmount` per line rounded on each line (Xero's "Rounding in Xero" guide), so it does not match one rounding per rate. One invoice is in USD. `TaxRates` and `Accounts` sit in the same object so `TaxType` and `AccountCode` can be resolved. |
| `qbo-invoices.json` | intuit/QuickBooks-V3-Java-SDK `c4d5dfa`, `Finance.xsd`: `Invoice` (L5803), `Bill` (L9498) and `TxnTaxDetail` (L5094), plus the Invoice and Bill samples and the sales-tax workflow pages in Intuit's developer docs. Lines are `SalesItemLineDetail`, `SubTotalLineDetail` and `AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail`; `TaxLine` carries `TaxPercent` and `NetAmountTaxable`. The voided invoice has zero amounts and `PrivateNote` `Voided`. Invoice 1039 has a US-style tax group (two `TaxLine`s on one base). |
| `xero-invoices.csv` | Xero Central "Import customer invoices" (UK, US, AU): one row per line, rows with the same `InvoiceNumber` form one invoice, `Discount` is a percentage, `TaxType` is the tax rate's display name, and an optional `TaxAmount` column. Dates are UK dd/mm/yyyy. The header follows the field names in the article with `*` on the columns third-party pages mark as required; the exact header of the login-only template is unverified. One invoice is in USD. |
| `xero-bills.csv` | Xero Central "Import bills and credit notes" (UK, US): the spaced column headings as printed in the article's table (`Contact Name`, `Unit Amount`, …), dates dd/mm/yyyy, two rows with the same `Invoice Number`. |
| `qbo-invoices.csv` | QuickBooks Help "Import multiple invoices at once" (US, UK) and Intuit's 2018 guide PDF: the 18-column sample header plus `ItemTaxCode` (the UK article requires an item tax code; its column name is unverified). Each row repeats the invoice number, customer and dates. |
| `freee-invoices.csv` | The format file attached to freee help article 18895523266841: the 47-column header verbatim, `本文` and `明細` rows, a `テキスト` line, `税率` values `10%`, `8% (軽減税率)` and `0%`, `税区分` `対象外`, amounts with thousands separators, and both `外税`/`切り捨て` and `内税`/`四捨五入`. |
| `freee-invoices.json` | freee/freee-api-schema `ac1acd4`, `iv/open-api-3/api-schema.yml`: `InvoiceShowResponse_invoice` (L5887) with per-rate `amount_*`, `tax_entry_method`, `tax_fraction`, `cancel_status`, a `text` line, and `template.invoice_registration_number`. |
| `mf-invoices.csv` | MoneyForward guide "帳票をCSVアップロードする方法" (do019): the 38 columns of the 縦並び sample (read from the guide's screenshot; the exact header is unverified), `csv_type(変更不可)` 40101, `請求書` and `品目` rows, `品目消費税率` values `10%`, `軽8%` and `不課税`, and `入金ステータス`. |
| `mf-invoices.json` | `iv_web_api.yaml` 3.6.0 (MF クラウド請求書 API v3): `Billing` (L1773) with string amounts, slash and dash dates, `excise_price_of_*`, `config.rounding` and `config.rounding_consumption_tax`. The second billing rounds lines down and tax up (102.65 × 2 → 205, tax 20.5 → 21). |
| `zoho-invoices.json` | Zoho Invoice OpenAPI `invoices.yml` (sha256 `53e03d28…`) and the API docs' list sample: `line_items` with `tax_percentage` and `item_total`, `taxes[]` with per-tax amounts, an entity-level discount, a void invoice, and a list item without lines. |
| `freshbooks-invoices.json` | FreshBooks `/api/invoices` and freshbooks-nodejs-sdk `f1e2d61b`: money as `{amount, code}` strings, `taxAmount1` as a percentage, `v3_status`, and a line with two taxes. |
| `freshbooks-bills.json` | FreshBooks `/api/bills` "Get Single Bill" sample: `quantity` as a string, `tax_percent1` and `tax_amount1`, `category` as an object, `vendorid` without a vendor name. |
| `ofx-bank.ofx` | OFX Banking Specification 1.0.2/1.6 (FDX): a 1.x SGML header (`OFXHEADER:100`, `DATA:OFXSGML`), leaf elements without end tags, `STMTRS` with `BANKACCTFROM` (`ACCTTYPE` `SAVINGS`), `STMTTRN` with `FITID`, a `DTPOSTED` with time and `[+9:JST]`, and `LEDGERBAL`. `SONRS/FI` carries `ORG`/`FID`. The names are half-width kana, as Japanese banks print remitters. Accessed 2026-10-23. |
| `ofx-card.qfx` | OFX Banking Specification 2.3 and its XSD (FDX, 2020-10-16): the XML declaration and the `<?OFX …?>` processing instruction, `CCSTMTRS`/`CCACCTFROM`, card purchases negative and a refund positive (§11.4.4.1), a `CORRECTFITID`/`CORRECTACTION DELETE` pair, a line with `CURRENCY` (not converted, §5.2), a decimal comma, and Intuit's private `INTU.BID` tag (ignored, §2.7.1). |
| `freee-statement-bank.csv`, `freee-statement-card.csv` | The template files attached to freee help articles 202847120 and 202847810: bank `取引日,出金額,入金額,残高,取引内容` and card `取引日,取引金額,取引内容,カードラベル` (a purchase is positive and a refund negative on cards), dates `YYYY/MM/DD`. |
| `mf-statement-sjis.csv` | MoneyForward support im01/im02: `日付,内容,出金額,入金額`, Shift_JIS (the sample is offered in Shift-JIS and UTF-8). The header bytes were read from the guide's screenshots; the login-only sample was not checked. |
| `xero-statement.csv` | Xero Central "Import a CSV bank statement": Date, Amount, Payee, Description, Reference and Cheque Number, spend negative written `(36.30)` or `-4.40`, dates dd/mm/yyyy. The `*` on Date and Amount follows third-party descriptions of the login-only template (unverified). |
| `qbo-bank-3col.csv`, `qbo-bank-4col.csv` | QuickBooks Help "Format CSV files in Excel to get bank transactions into QuickBooks" (L4BjLWckq): the 3-column `Date,Description,Amount` and the 4-column `Date,Description,Credit,Debit`, where Intuit's own example puts a payment under Credit and a deposit under Debit. |
| `zengin-03-sjis.txt` | 全銀協 "XML形式 適用業務およびレコード・フォーマット" (2026-10 revision, the fixed-length field lists in its mapping appendix) and the byte offsets in 北陸銀行's spec: 入出金取引明細 (種別 03), 200-byte header, three data records, trailer and end records, 和暦 YYMMDD dates, 入払区分 1/2, CRLF, Shift_JIS (single-byte JIS X 0201). The trailer's counts, sums and closing balance agree with the data. |
| `zengin-01-sjis.txt` | The same document's 振込入金通知 (種別 01) フォーマット A: 7-digit account number in the header, one transfer, a trailer, and an end record of `9` plus 199 spaces. |
| `zengin-03.csv` | 山梨中央銀行 Biz_format_09.pdf and GMOあおぞらネット銀行 business-account.pdf: the 種別 03 fields as CSV in the same order, with dummy fields as empty strings. |
| `mufg-biz-nyuushukkin.csv` | 三菱UFJ銀行 "入出金明細（CSV形式）出力フォーマット" (nyuushukkin_csv.pdf, 2022-12-08): the 20-column header, every field quoted, 取引日 as 和暦 YYMMDD, 入払区分 1/2, zero-padded amounts, Shift_JIS. |
| `mufg-personal.csv`, `paypay-bank.csv`, `vpass.csv` | Unverified bank and card layouts, taken from third-party parsers only (felica2money @a8a136e, Hyuaran paypay-parser.ts @0f90ed5, vpass-csv-converter @ff6d7d1 and MoneyRabbit @db6e248). They test kaikei's column mapping, not the banks' real files. |
| `ramp-list.json` | Ramp OpenAPI `developer-api.json` (`info.version` v1): a `{data, page}` list with `Transaction` (`entity_amount` in minor units, a refund with `original_transaction_id`, a `DECLINED` row with `decline_details`, `accounting_field_selections` of type `GL_ACCOUNT`/`TAX_CODE`), `Reimbursement` (`direction` `BUSINESS_TO_USER` and `USER_TO_BUSINESS`) and `Bill` (`vendor`, `invoice_number`, `CurrencyAmount` line items). Ramp publishes no sample responses, so this is built from the schema. |
| `brex-transactions.json`, `brex-expenses.json` | Brex Transactions API 1.0 (`Page_CardTransaction_`: `items`, `next_cursor`; `type` `PURCHASE`, `REFUND`, `COLLECTION`) and Expenses API 0.1 (`ExpandableExpense`: `expense_type` `REIMBURSEMENT` and `CARD`, `status`, `billing_amount`). Money is in minor units. The `COLLECTION` amount is negative to show that kaikei keys on `type`, not sign. |
| `expensify.csv`, `expensify-jpy.csv` | The CSV that kaikei's Report Exporter template (`kaikei.compat.expensify/template`) prints, with field names from Expensify's template reference: cents, `reimbursable`, `taxAmount`, report status. The template has not been run against Expensify. |
| `bill-bills.json` | BILL v3 `listbills` (`results`) and `BillReadResponseDto`, with the ap-bills guide's sample line items (USB audio interface $149.00 and drum foot pedal $79.99), decimal major units, and a `DRAFT` bill. |
| `xero-manual-journal.csv` | Xero Central "Add, import and post manual journals" (UK). Only the first row of a journal has Narration and Date, the Amount is signed, and dates are dd/mm/yyyy. Whether the header has the `*` prefix is unverified. |

Line endings are CRLF.
